tracks.title: Meetings and client calls
tracks.subtitle: Speak clearly and confidently in stand-ups, client calls and meetings.

units.title: Daily stand-up
units.goal: Give a clear yesterday / today / blockers update.
examplePhrases: I'm blocked on… and need help from…

units.title: Opening a call and small talk
units.goal: Start a call smoothly and make light conversation.

units.title: Giving a status update
units.goal: Report progress clearly on a client call.

units.title: Explaining a delay or a problem
units.goal: Explain a delay honestly and give a new plan.
examplePhrases: Unfortunately, we've run into an issue with…

units.title: Asking for clarification
units.goal: Check what someone means without sounding unsure.
examplePhrases: Could you clarify what you mean by…?

units.title: When you don't have the answer
units.goal: Promise a follow-up professionally instead of guessing.
examplePhrases: Let me check and get back to you by…
That's a good question. I'll confirm with the team.

units.title: Agreeing, disagreeing and pushing back
units.goal: Disagree politely and suggest alternatives.

units.title: Interrupting and joining in
units.goal: Get your point into a busy conversation.

units.title: Negotiating scope and deadlines
units.goal: Trade scope against time without saying a flat no.
examplePhrases: If we move the deadline to…, we can include…

units.title: Demos and presenting your work
units.goal: Walk a client through your work on a shared screen.

units.title: Escalations and difficult clients
units.goal: Stay calm and constructive when a client is unhappy.
examplePhrases: Here's what we're doing to fix it.

units.title: Summarising and closing
units.goal: End a call with clear action items.
examplePhrases: I'll send the minutes after the call.

tracks.title: Job interviews
tracks.subtitle: Answer confidently in HR, technical and managerial rounds.

units.title: Tell me about yourself
units.goal: Give a 60–90 second introduction built from your real background.
examplePhrases: I'm a Java developer with three years of experience in…

units.title: Your current role
units.goal: Describe your responsibilities clearly.
examplePhrases: In my current role, I'm responsible for…

units.title: Projects with STAR
units.goal: Tell a project story: situation, task, action, result.
examplePhrases: As a result, response time dropped by…

units.title: Technical explanations in simple English
units.goal: Explain your stack and design choices clearly.

units.title: Teamwork and conflict
units.goal: Describe a disagreement and how you resolved it.

units.title: Strengths and weaknesses
units.goal: Answer honestly without sounding memorised.

units.title: Why are you leaving? Why us?
units.goal: Frame your move positively.
examplePhrases: I'm looking for a role where I can…
What attracts me to your company is…

units.title: Salary, notice period and joining date
units.goal: Discuss terms clearly and professionally.
examplePhrases: My notice period is 60 days, and it's negotiable.

units.title: Questions to ask the interviewer
units.goal: End the interview with thoughtful questions.
examplePhrases: What does success look like in this role?

units.title: HR and managerial rounds
units.goal: Handle situational questions and say "I don't know" gracefully.
examplePhrases: I haven't worked with that yet, but I'd approach it by…
